description: Sixteen-channel stereo mixer with twelve mono channels, four stereo channels, two aux sends and returns, four groups, voltage control of every level and pan, and four scenes

params.text: Sets the level of the whole mix, marked from +6dB down to silence and starting at 0dB
Sets how much of the AUX 1 return is folded into the mix, marked from +6dB down to silence and starting at silence
Sets how much of the AUX 2 return is folded into the mix, marked from +6dB down to silence and starting at silence
Pans the AUX 1 return between the left and right outputs
Pans the AUX 2 return between the left and right outputs
Sends that channel to one of the four groups, or straight to the master mix
Sets the level of that group, marked from +6dB down to silence and starting at 0dB
Pans that group between the left and right outputs
Sets how much of that group is sent to AUX 1
Sets how much of that group is sent to AUX 2
Sets how much of that channel is sent to AUX 1
Sets how much of that channel is sent to AUX 2
Sets the level of that channel, marked from +6dB down to silence and starting at 0dB
Pans that channel between the left and right outputs
Attenuates the voltage at that channel's pan CV input before it moves the pan
Switches that channel in and out of the mix
Solos that channel; while any solo on the module is on, only soloed channels reach the outputs
Solos that group; while any solo on the module is on, only soloed channels and groups reach the outputs
Switches that group in and out of the mix
Switches the mixer to that scene, each scene carrying its own set of channel mutes and solos
Swaps the two rows of aux send knobs for the pan CV attenuators and the track routing buttons

inputs.text: Takes the channels back from a polyphonic cable, replacing what the insert output sent
Voltage control of the AUX 1 return level
Voltage control of the AUX 2 return level
Voltage control of the AUX 1 return pan
Voltage control of the AUX 2 return pan
The left side of the AUX 1 return
The left side of the AUX 2 return
The right side of the AUX 1 return
The right side of the AUX 2 return
Voltage control of that group's level
Voltage control of that group's pan
The signal for that mono channel, read as a single monophonic voltage
The left side of that stereo channel
The right side of that stereo channel
Voltage control of that channel's send to AUX 1
Voltage control of that channel's send to AUX 2
Voltage control of that channel's pan, attenuated by that channel's CV TO PAN knob
Voltage control of that channel's level

outputs.text: Carries the first eight channels after their faders as one polyphonic cable, despite the panel printing INSERT 1 - 12
The left side of the AUX 1 send
The left side of the AUX 2 send
The right side of the AUX 1 send
The right side of the AUX 2 send
The left side of the mix
The right side of the mix

menu: DC block — puts a DC blocking filter on each channel
Show CV pan attenuators — swaps the two rows of aux send knobs for the pan CV attenuators and the track routing buttons, the same swap the display button makes
Copy Scene — takes a copy of the mutes and solos stored in the scene now selected
Paste Scene — writes the copied mutes and solos into the scene now selected
